prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1268; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state the date and time of the accident for the record. Actually, skip the exact date. Just tell me where it happened.

A: It happened on a two-lane road in Baytown, Texas, near an intersection with a gas station on the corner.

Q: Thank you. Can you describe how the collision occurred?

A: I was driving toward the store when a car coming the other way drifted into my lane. We were going slowly, maybe walking speed, but we still hit front to front.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbag did not deploy, but I hit the steering wheel with my arms up.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that evening. They took X-rays and told me my left wrist was fractured. I have a splint now and I see a hand specialist next week.

Q: Did you have any injuries before this accident involving that wrist?

A: No. I had never broken anything in that arm before.

Q: Has anyone else been in contact with you about the accident?

A: The other driver's insurance company called me once. I told them I would wait until I spoke with you.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that my car is still at the repair shop and I have been using a rental for work. I want to make sure those costs are covered while I recover.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Okay, thank you.
